title: He Crushed a Whole Egg Sack in His Fist and the System Went Crazy . . . (highlight)
caption:
Dokja Kim crushes a grasshopper egg sack to beat Namwoon Kim in Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#omniscientreadersviewpoint #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #fyp

segments.say: Dokja asks if an insect egg counts as an organism, then crushes the whole sack in his *fist*.
To see how it got here, go back to a kid named Namwoon, who has business with an old *lady*.
Dokja grabs his wrist, and Namwoon sneers that he is playing *hero*.
Then Namwoon wakes his skill, and one slam sends Dokja crashing *backward*.
Then Dokja's head starts pounding, and a message says he just unlocked a new *skill*.
So Namwoon eyes the old lady, because if she dies he clears the scenario, and he throws a *knife*.
Dokja dives in front of her, and the blade burns his *skin*.
The strong eat the weak, Namwoon says. If Dokja hesitates, he *dies*.
So Dokja asks if an insect egg counts as an organism, then crushes the sack in his *fist*.
The system dings like crazy, because a grasshopper lays over a hundred eggs. That was *savage*.
Dokja puts twenty-seven hundred coins into stamina, and the knife suddenly can't *touch* him.
Namwoon swings and screams, why won't you *die*?
The full story is on our page.
